text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on Seasons Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. This report recommends that City Council prohibit U-turns on Seasons Drive, between Oasis Boulevard and Grosbeak Crescent. Prohibiting U-turns will provide a safer environment for all road users along this section of Seasons Drive located adjacent to Blessed Pier Giorgio Frassati Catholic School.

City Council on June 29 and 30, 2020 adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit eastbound and westbound U-turn movements at all times on Seasons Drive, between Oasis Boulevard and Grosbeak Crescent.
